page.overview:
What is Porygon?

Porygon is a virtual Pokémon. It is based on early 3D animation models and created completely out of polygons. It resembles a duck or some type of bird. The various parts of Porygon's body are colored pink, white, and blue. Its eyes are in the shape of hexagons.

Porygon is the first artificial Pokémon, created by the scientists at the Silph Co. company.

Porygon evolves into Porygon2 if traded while holding an Upgrade and then evolves into Porygon-Z if traded while holding a Dubious Disc.

Porygon is based on . It is also stylized after an .
